transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?

This morning at about 8, while I was eating breakfast, my right arm suddenly went weak and my speech became slurred. I can’t lift a cup or grip with my right hand, and my husband can’t understand some of my words. It’s been like this since then and hasn’t improved.

Thank you for telling me. What you just described can be a sign of something that needs urgent attention. I am pausing these questions. Please seek medical help now: call your local emergency number or tell a member of staff right away.
